name: The Widow
source:
Quiet and timid, the Widow is often the talk of the town due to her reclusive nature―especially after the passing of her Husband, the beloved town doctor. When she can't hide any longer, rumours drive her to disappear into the woods―but there, she faces an even darker enemy.

[From [url=https://florisam.itch.io/the-widows-shadow]Itch.io[/url]]

[spoiler]Her name is Hilda.[/spoiler]
